title: Sexual Purity
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Sexual purity means honoring God with the body, desires, thoughts, and relationships according to His Word. God calls His people to reject sexual immorality and to pursue holiness in both inward desire and outward conduct.
summary: Sexual purity means honoring God with the body, desires, thoughts, and relationships according to His Word. God calls His people to reject sexual immorality and to pursue holiness in both inward desire and outward conduct.
christFocus: Jesus Christ redeems both body and soul. He forgives sexual sin, cleanses shame, breaks bondage, and calls His people to holiness as those bought with His blood.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sexual purity matters because the body belongs to the Lord. Scripture does not treat sexuality as meaningless, casual, or disconnected from worship. Believers are called to glorify God with their bodies.

God’s command against sexual immorality reaches both behavior and desire. Jesus addresses lust in the heart, showing that purity is more than outward reputation.

Sexual sin often promises freedom while producing bondage, shame, secrecy, and harm. Scripture calls believers to flee immorality rather than negotiate with it.

The Gospel gives hope. Those who have sinned sexually are not beyond cleansing in Christ, and those who battle temptation are not left without help. Holiness is possible by grace, truth, the Spirit, and faithful obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people carry confusion, shame, addiction, trauma, or distorted teaching around sexuality. This doctrine brings sexuality back under God’s good authority and Christ’s redeeming grace.

It also protects others from harm. Sexual purity is not only personal morality; it is love for God and neighbor through honoring bodies, boundaries, vows, and dignity.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring your body, desires, thoughts, habits, and relationships under the lordship of Christ. Flee what feeds lust, confess what is hidden, seek help where bondage exists, and trust that Christ can cleanse, restore, and teach you to walk in holiness.
